scope.description: ReadIndex identity preservation through leader prefix confirmation and response delivery, within one stable term and unchanged three-voter membership. Distinct originating followers each have exactly one pending context; all messages are produced by the implementation.
assumptions: Crash-free peers with serialized Peer API calls and compliant persistence/update acknowledgement.
Finite controlled network scheduling may delay earlier-context heartbeats while later-context heartbeats are delivered; no fabricated sender or confirmation.
No context reuse, role transition or membership change during the read interval.
excluded: A guarantee that every read succeeds rather than times out.
Client ReadLocal endpoint, stale data, linearizability violation, or global progress consequence.
Crash recovery and real storage/network behavior.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Use captured in-memory TestLogDB instead of engine LogDB and deterministic delivery queues instead of transport. No crashes or storage failures occur.
Driver persists State and EntriesToSave before any message delivery, applies bootstrap config/no-op entries, acknowledges Update and reports applied index.
Private state is read only for prefix/admission diagnostics; all protocol state changes use Peer methods.

plan_uncertainties: This observes the actual Peer readiness output, not client RequestState completion or application read data.
The serial control and overlap histories establish no crash recovery or membership-transition result.
No success deadline is asserted; a missing result remains incomplete rather than proving infinite stalling.
